fields.summary: Plan run on change set 01M61GW8H (Questions not permissions), autonomous, so no owner interview. The intent: Rex status shows a session's AskUserQuestion as a question for the owner, not as 'Claude needs your permission'. Code read: the Claude Code adapter maps AskUserQuestion to blocked with kind question (internal/adapter/claudecode/claudecode.go:162); run status and the run's OSC 7501 report carry kind question (internal/api/run.go:1641, internal/api/session_run.go:502); the run-blocked script asserts state=blocked:kind=question (cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/run-blocked.txtar:61). The Rex program status spec lists question as a valid kind (superlogical docs, build/program-status). The 'needs your permission' wording is not produced in this repo, so it is parked as a question for the owner.
fields.title: Questions not permissions: plan run, no owner present
